title: Apply for a riding instructor licence
summary: This page provides information on the requirements and steps to apply for a riding instructor licence in NSW.
intro:
If you want to teach an unlicensed person to ride a motorcycle in return for money or reward, you need to hold a riding instructor licence.

To get a rider instructor licence you need to:

When you successfully complete the course Transport for NSW will determine your suitability to hold an instructor licence.
who_can_apply: Hold a current full (unrestricted) Australian rider licence (Class R).
Have held the unrestricted licence for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years.
Hold, or be applying for, an employee working with children check (WWCC) number.
Be a fit and proper person.
Have a safe riding record (parking offences excluded).
what_you_need: A commercial medical assessment (no more than 6 months prior).
Successful completion of the rider instructor knowledge test.
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate rider licence).
A full riding record/history from the authority in the state or country where you previously held your rider licence (if you haven't held a NSW rider licence for more than 5 years).
The completed PDF form: 'Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992' (Do not sign this until you get to the service centre).

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.

Download and complete the Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992 – PDF.Note: Do not sign the application until you get to the service centre – your signature must be witnessed at the service centre.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: Motorcycle instructors must be accredited by Transport for NSW to instruct in the NSW Rider Training Scheme.

faqs.q: Who needs a riding instructor licence?
faqs.a: You need a riding instructor licence if you want to teach an unlicensed person to ride a motorcycle in return for money or reward.

faqs.q: What are the fees associated with becoming a riding instructor?
faqs.a: The fees include the riding instructor knowledge test, pre-learner rider training course and Motorcycle Operator Skills Test (MOST), which must be passed with a 100% result, and a non-refundable 5-year driving instructor licence fee.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You must check eligibility, select 'Apply online', follow the prompts, and then visit a service centre to submit your application.
